caption: A cold bottle of soda has just been taken out of the fridge on a hot day, and beads of water form on the outside of the bottle.

sa.check: A bottle of soda is present.
Beads of water form on the outside of the bottle.
The bottle reads as cold and just out of the fridge: an open fridge, chill haze or frost on the glass.
The setting is a hot day: sun, outdoors or a warm room.
The bottle is a soda bottle with a label and cap.

pc.expect: The condensation builds: a haze, then droplets that grow and multiply; the bottle's surface gets wetter, never drier, while it is out.
pc.fail: The droplets shrink or vanish while the bottle sits; or the surface fogs and clears repeatedly; or the beading reduces over the clip.

pc.expect: Droplets that grow large enough run downward, leaving trails; water gathers at the bottom of the bottle or on the surface beneath.
pc.fail: A drop runs upward or sideways along the bottle; or water collects on top of the cap; or a drop leaves the bottle and floats.

pc.expect: The water appears only on the outside of the cold bottle, as beads on the surface.
pc.fail: Beads form on the inside of the bottle or on the table away from the bottle; or drops detach and drift off into the air.

pc.expect: The beads behave as water on glass or plastic: they stay round, merge when they touch, and run as streaks.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the surface; or the beads turn to hard frost while the bottle sweats.

pc.expect: One bottle keeps its shape and cap; nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: The bottle changes shape; or a second bottle appears or the bottle vanishes; or the cap comes off by itself; or the liquid inside passes through the wall.

pc.expect: The label, cap colour and soda colour stay the same; the background stays put.
pc.fail: The label text or colour changes; or the soda changes colour; or background objects shift.
